lunar_isru_delivery_lead_months.basis: Conservative upper endpoint of the official 1-2 month CASE_INPUT range after commissioning.

monthly_demand_allocation.basis: Annual demand is divided equally across twelve model months.

real_discount_rate.basis: Demonstration real rate; the team must justify it before final submission.

storage_average_method.basis: Monthly holding cost uses the mean of opening and closing physical inventory.

week_to_model_month_conversion.basis: Emergency six-week lead time is converted to ceil(42 / (365/12)) = 2 model months.
